authorization: Publisher explicitly authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Recurring diagnostics revenue is compounding through instrument placements, consumable use and reference-lab volumes, but durability depends on utilisation and cash conversion rather than placements alone.

identity.units: USD millions except per-share, percentage and instrument data

duplicate_checks: Checked EDITORIAL_TOPIC_INDEX.md, CONTENT_INVENTORY.md, data/content-inventory.json and actual wealth Markdown; IDEXX has a stock profile but no dedicated recurring-diagnostics analysis.
Checked recent company-publication records, merged and open pull requests, and live site content; no matching IDEXX story or fingerprint was active or published.
Routine results remain on /stocks/idxx/; this article addresses the installed-base and recurring-revenue economics.

evidence_table.claim: Q3 revenue was USD1.214237bn, up 10% rounded, while diluted EPS was USD4.01 and net income USD317.145m.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release headline and consolidated tables; 1,214.237 / 1,105.239 - 1 = 9.862%, rounded to 10%.

evidence_table.claim: CAG diagnostics recurring revenue grew 11%; VetLab consumables grew 14% reported and 15% organic; reference-lab revenue grew 10%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release CAG highlights and 10-Q CAG revenue discussion.
evidence_table.result: verified; reported and organic measures distinguished

evidence_table.claim: More than 1,900 inVue Dx analysers were placed and its installed base approached 11,000; the global premium instrument installed base grew 11%.
evidence_table.result: verified; instrument revenue was flat and lower price realisation is stated

evidence_table.claim: Gross margin was 62.9%, up 110 basis points, and operating margin 33.1%, up 100 basis points.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release gross-profit and operating-profit section and 10-Q consolidated MD&A.
evidence_table.result: verified as GAAP; comparable measures not substituted

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month operating cash flow was USD1.063127bn versus USD826.045m; full-year capex plan was about USD160m.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: 10-Q sources and uses of cash; increase recomputed as USD237.082m.
evidence_table.result: verified; acquisition spending not treated as capex

evidence_table.claim: Updated revenue guidance was USD4.741bn-USD4.767bn, EPS USD14.96-USD15.16 and operating margin 32.1%-32.3%.
evidence_table.result: verified; operating-margin range is lower than prior 32.3%-32.5%

fact_check_pass.method: After drafting, every material number, period, accounting label, management explanation and calculation was reread against the SEC-furnished release and Form 10-Q; arithmetic was independently recomputed.
